In the explicitly selected Chrome session, I will use the exact ordered manifest queries without translation:
1. `mini dress`
2. `puff sleeve mini dress`

The missing sold count does not reject this SHEIN candidate because its 245 reviews and 4.8 rating are the two required platform metrics and both pass their task thresholds. I will keep the Base dry-run boundary and will not browse or write either Base for this forward evaluation.
